item.title: Cooking a holiday meal with less counter space than you need
item.description: A seasonal plan for cooking a holiday meal in a small kitchen: what to move off the counter, what to cook in a second appliance, and which temperatures actually matter.

item.title: Probe or instant-read: which thermometer do you actually need?
item.description: How to choose between an instant-read thermometer and a wireless leave-in probe: read speed, what each is rated for, app dependence, battery and cleaning.

item.title: Is your meat thermometer telling you the right number?
item.description: The USDA safe minimum internal temperatures, where to place a probe in poultry and cuts, why a 1,000 °F rating is not an oil rating, and how to check a thermometer at home.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: Nine questions to ask before buying a multi-function countertop appliance: which functions you will use weekly, whether presets match your food, what the manual documents, and what is actually in the box.

item.title: Cleanup and counter space: how to weigh the two costs nobody photographs
item.description: How to compare air fryer cleanup effort and counter footprint before buying: parts count, dishwasher wording, nonstick care, depth, door swing and cabinet clearance.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: How to read air fryer capacity: total versus per-basket quarts, why litres and quarts disagree, what inside dimensions mean, and what to measure in your own kitchen before you buy.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: A buyer's guide to choosing between a basket air fryer and an oven-style air fryer, built on the four comparisons that change the decision: batch shape, what you can see, what you must clean, and how much counter it eats.
